mostWorthwhile.text: Reinforcing the platelet plug was most worthwhile because it showed how the mesh helps stop the leak without repairing the surface cut.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the cut was straightforward setup; it was clear but less interesting than seeing how the plug worked.

surprise.text: The plug slowed the bleeding before the protein mesh stopped it, while the skin above remained open.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. The thread-making step followed the enzyme label and was the only offered combination at that point.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue to see how the open skin heals, since stopping the bleeding left that question unresolved.
